title: perf(dsv41): SP ratio-2 compressor projection and CED encoder-only chunks
verdict_reason: The rebase keeps both of #956's mechanisms on the new base and keeps the gain. Every output the harness compares is byte-identical to candidate-54 + 957-p1. On one GPU at TP4 rank shapes, a ratio-2 layer's SP prefill step is 16.8-22.9% faster at 4K-64K rows, with every candidate boot below every base boot. The patch applies after 957-p1 and the pair check is clean. The fabric share of the gain and the CED encoder-only gain need the coordinator's servebench prefill on tp4-switched.

patch.message: the PR's message (Upstream base line updated to candidate-54 + 957-p1) plus a 'Round 3 rebase (candidate-56, after #957 part 1 on candidate-54)' section: what each base patch changed, the bit-exactness evidence, the round-3 tests and the own mark (raw/commit-msg.txt)

semantics_kept: DeepseekCompressor._sp_enabled for compress_ratio in (1, 2); at ratio 2, _sp_projection_call is bf16_gemm_two(512, 5120, out_dtype=float32, shards/blocked of the layer's split); forward() projects this rank's local rows into _values/_gates and gathers both with sp_rows.gather_many before the TileLang compression, whose new gates argument defaults to self._gates

layers 2, 8, 14 (ratio-2 compressor) and 20 (ratio 1, when it runs as an ordinary SP layer) take the SP local attention front instead of gathering the BF16 hidden state, and their global KV comes from _prepare_global_kv(local rows, sp_rows)

CEDState.encoder_only / DeepseekV4Model._ced_encoder_only: a step in which every request is a non-final prefill chunk ending at or before its replay floor stops at the CED boundary after mhc.pre and prepare_global_kv and returns preallocated zeros (hidden and aux states; sink columns zeroed); model.py and model_state.py hunks unchanged from the PR

conflicts.attention.py vs 0778 (#1009 round 1, sp_: #1009 r1 replaced the BF16 _gather_front (norms + copy_columns/split_columns + one BF16 gather) that the PR extended to compressor layers with _sp_front: sp_attention_front writes the MXFP8 q cast and 528-byte SWA records on local rows, one grouped gather_mxfp8 carries them, write_swa_records stores them, and index head weights stay rank-local in prefill steps (gathered in SP decode steps). The rebase routes the SP compressor layers into that branch (condition: compressor is None, or a DeepseekCompressor whose _sp_kernel is bound) instead of re-adding the BF16 front, keeps the local rows for the compressor, and declares sp_front_call and swa_records_call for SP compressor layers (the PR's copy_columns/split_columns declarations had no caller left). forward_mqa never reads kv, so the front's kv=None suffices for compressor layers.
conflicts.attention.py vs 0765 (#1012 round 1, dec: _can_overlap_decode refuses SP steps (sp_rows is not None), so the PR's SP global-KV call sits in the non-overlapped branch beside the full-row call it replaced; the overlapped path (full rows, _project_local/_finish_project then _forward_tilelang without values/gates) reads the same buffers as before because the new gates argument defaults to self._gates.
conflicts.ced.py vs 0788 (#960 round 1, pinned hos: CEDState.encoder_only is declared after self.plan, beside the pinned limits/floors staging rings; warm_metadata resets it as in the PR. stage_floors (FULL-graph staging) does not touch it: the model reads its flag only at the CED boundary, which runs only with compacted ced_indices, and those come only from _stage_ced, which sets the flag every eager step.
conflicts.compressor.py with 957-p1: 957-p1 replicates fused_wkv_wgate unpacked through TP4 (tp_size 1), so bind() takes the tp_size <= 1 branch: the ratio-2 SP weight is the [1024, 5120] layer weight itself (same storage, no all-gather, no extra memory), and the SP kernel is the same bf16_gemm_two call the replicated layer's own prefill GEMM makes. Above TP4 the PR's gather-and-unpad of the sharded weight is kept (10 MiB a ratio-2 layer a rank). The hunks merged cleanly; the bind() comment and sp_prefill's module notes were updated.

added: tests/models/test_deepseek_v4_1_compressor.py::test_sp_ratio2_projection_matches_full_rows (GPU): the PR's bf16_gemm_two check, as a test, at TP2..TP8 through the real bind()
sp_prefill.py module notes: compressor layers take the local front; the full-weight exception holds only above TP4
not_changed_on_purpose: model_state.stage_full_cudagraph_attn leaves the encoder_only flag (see ced.py above); a stale flag cannot act without compacted indices
ced_sp_saves_bytes stays ratio-1 only (the boundary is ratio 1)

bit_exactness.verdict: bit-identical to candidate-54 + 957-p1 in every compared output

projection_test.what: each rank's bf16_gemm_two on its SP local rows (bound by declare_kernels/bind as serving binds it), gathered, against TP1 project_parts on all rows (= every TP<=4 rank's replicated projection; = the sharded project_parts + gather_columns_into above TP4, which 957-p1's test checks equal to TP1), 129/205/206/207/257/385/4097/16384 rows, finite and NaN/Inf inputs, values and gates compared as int32 bits
projection_test.result: 7/7 world sizes equal bit for bit; through TP4 the SP weight shares the layer weight's storage and bind() makes no all-gather; above TP4 bind() gathers once and the unpadded weight equals [wkv; wgate]
projection_test.on_base: fails on candidate-54 + 957-p1 (ratio 2 has no SP projection there)

attention_harness.what: vLLM's own DeepseekV41TileLangAttention for layers 2 (ratio-2 KV/index/candidate source with state ring) and 20 (ratio 1) at TP rank shapes on one GPU, compressor built as a TP-W rank builds it, random checkpoint-dtype weights, real caches and B12X metadata; each rank's forward under SPRows with the TP all-gather simulated to a fixed point; compared per rank: WO input (attention output), top-k indices, and every owned cache (SWA, main KV, index K, ratio-2 state ring)
attention_harness.scenarios: whole prefills of 4,096, 4,097 and 16,384 rows; a chunked prefill 4,097 + 4,096 + 2,051 rows with caches and the state ring carried between chunks; 90 decode rows beside a 4,006-row prefill; SP decode steps of 214 and 216 rows
attention_harness.result: 18/18 cells byte-identical across base and candidate and across boots at TP4 and TP3 (serving environment, no breakable graphs), and 18/18 with breakable graphs (the fallback front); every rank agrees with every other on output, top-k and caches; all outputs finite. The base gathers the 10,240-byte BF16 hidden row; the candidate gathers the MXFP8 q cast (1,320 B), SWA records (528 B) and FP32 values+gates (4,096 B at ratio 2, 1,024 B BF16 values at ratio 1).
attention_harness.decode: non-SP decode never enters the changed code (the decode overlap and the full-row path are the base's); SP decode steps (214, 216 rows) are covered above

bit_exactness.ced_encoder_only: not measurable on one GPU (needs the full model). The early exit applies only when every request of the step is a non-final prefill chunk ending at or before its replay floor (replay_rows gives each such request one dummy row, its last, replayed from itself: requests_kernel replay = min(floor, position)). Its decoder rows and DSpark context rows lie before the floor, and every later decoder or draft window starts at or after it (CED replay start; bind_draft_replay_start), so no later output reads them; the runner discards the chunk's sampled token. The final chunk is never encoder-only, so its decoder rows and logits are the base's. test_deepseek_v41_ced_receptive_field.py's oracle states the same property. End-to-end confirmation: the screen's greedy identity at 32K and 256K prefill on tp4-switched (multi-chunk prompts).
bit_exactness.pr_check_kept: the PR's bf16_gemm_two vs project_parts + gather_columns_into check is now the GPU test above (TP5..TP8 sharded; TP2..TP4 against the replicated projection 957-p1 makes)

own_mark.what: a rank's SP prefill forward of one compressor layer (shim/bench_layers.py): layers 2 (ratio 2, the changed path of layers 2, 8, 14) and 20 (ratio 1, as an ordinary SP layer), one request's chunk of T rows, TP4 rank shapes on one GPU; each all-gather is a device copy of the gathered rows (no fabric); CUDA events around each forward, 8 warmup + 40 timed forwards a cell, ranks alternating
own_mark.arms: base = spark-ds41f:candidate-50 (8c1ea1f62f62) + candidate-54 + 957-p1 tree mounted; cand = the same + the rebased 956
own_mark.order: one session, ABBA: base boot1, cand boot1, cand boot2, base boot2 (fresh container each, serving environment)
own_mark.statistic: each boot's median over all ranks' forwards; the change is the mean of boot medians with a Student-t 95% interval (df 2); 'slowest_rank' is in raw/json/bench-cells.json
own_mark.summary: layer 2: -21.5% (4K), -22.9% (8K), -22.0% (16K, the served chunk: 33.41 -> 26.06 ms), -20.4% (32K), -16.8% (64K); every candidate boot below every base boot in every cell; layer 20 -14.4..-22.0%. Per 16K chunk this is about 7.3 ms a ratio-2 layer of rank compute and local copies, about 22 ms over layers 2, 8 and 14, before any fabric saving; each rank sends 7,992 instead of 12,288 bytes a row at ratio 2 (4,920 at ratio 1).
own_mark.64K_cell: the largest chunk is 65,535 rows: the sparse MLA extend kernel's grid.y is the row count and CUDA caps it at 65,535, so 65,536 rows fail to launch in both arms (the first attempt, kept as raw/bench-base-boot1-T65536-aborted.txt, ran the base to 32K before stopping there). tp4-switched serves chunks of at most 16,384 rows.
own_mark.not_in_it: fabric time and the CED encoder-only saving (the decoder layers it skips need the full model and the cluster's MoE all-to-all)

servebench_for_coordinator.what: the PR's own evidence: servebench prefill on tp4-switched, bin/spark --cluster-config <candidate-56 tp4-switched config> --shape tp4-switched bench, 3 repeats a context, deterministic source-text slice, at 32,768 / 65,536 / 131,072 / 262,144 target tokens (the PR on 1107: +2.31% / +0.44% / +1.67% / +1.71% vs 1107's tp4-switched record; raw/956 README numbers in the PR folder)
servebench_for_coordinator.how: same session, ABBA, two boots each: candidate-56 (957-p1 + 956) against a no956 control on the same image (no956/overlay/: candidate-54 + 957-p1's copies of 956's six source files; 957-p1 is the only other patch touching them and 956 applies after it), so the mark isolates #956 from 957-p1's own prefill change; the screen's prefill steps at 32K and 256K with greedy identity cover the bit-exactness end to end
servebench_for_coordinator.expected: prefill tok/s not worse at any context, better at 32K-256K: the ratio-2 layers' local front and projection (this mark) plus the encoder-only exit on every non-final 16K chunk (the PR: about 28-32 ms a non-final chunk on tp4-switched)
servebench_for_coordinator.watch: an encoder-only step returns zero hidden states, so its discarded sample row reaches the greedy vocabulary screen (0762+ certified two-pass head) with a zero vector, where every column ties and the screen refines the whole vocabulary shard for that row: about one head GEMV (~1 ms) a non-final chunk, an estimate not measured here, well under the decoder work skipped

memory: TP <= 4: no static change (the SP weight is the replicated layer weight); transient per ratio-2 layer at T rows: FP32 values+gates gathers of T x 4,096 B instead of the T x 10,240 B BF16 hidden gather and its MXFP8 cast. TP5..TP8: +10 MiB a ratio-2 layer a rank (30 MiB), the PR's gathered weight.
